_comment: SHARED FIXTURE — the fact-vs-label rule has two implementations and this file is
what stops them drifting. It is read by BOTH:
A change to either implementation that is not matched in the other fails on one side.
Two implementations exist deliberately, not by accident: the lint must read the LIVE
component library from the database on a schedule (a Go job there would need a clone
and a compile — see the CronJob's design note), while the gate must run inside the Go
write path with no DB. RFC_009 records the choice. This file is the price of it.
'expect' is the fact-shape name, or null when the literal is a legitimate label that
must NOT be refused. Add a case here FIRST when you change a pattern.
